title: MD Day Trips · Millersville
note: Real Maryland parks, museums, and Chesapeake spots from Millersville. Drive times are EXAMPLE bands — always check traffic and official sites for hours.
weatherTipFallback: Pair with NWS Annapolis board — check forecast before outdoor parks or water.

places.name: Quiet Waters Park
places.why: Trails, playground, South River views — classic Anne Arundel outing for Char & Vic.
places.hoursNote: Check official site for hours & boat rental season.

places.name: Sandy Point State Park
places.why: Bay beach, fishing, and bridge views — summer water day without leaving AA County.
places.hoursNote: Check DNR for beach conditions, fees, and winter hours.

places.name: Downs Park
places.why: Chesapeake shoreline trails and playgrounds close to KPD / Millersville.

places.name: Patapsco Valley State Park
places.why: River trails, rock outcrops, and picnic areas — classic central MD hike day.
places.hoursNote: Multiple areas (Avalon, Hollofield, etc.) — check DNR map & fees.

places.name: Jug Bay Wetlands Sanctuary
places.why: Boardwalks and Patuxent marshes — quiet nature for binoculars and kid energy.
places.hoursNote: Check official site; some programs need registration.

places.name: Smithsonian Environmental Research Center
places.why: Public visitor trails and campus on the Rhode River — science + woods near Annapolis.
places.hoursNote: Visitor access rules change — check serc.si.edu before you go.

places.name: Historic downtown Annapolis
places.why: State House, City Dock, Ego Alley, ice cream — easy half-day with waterfront energy.
places.hoursNote: Parking & event calendars on City of Annapolis / Visit Annapolis sites.

places.name: Baltimore Museum of Industry
places.why: Hands-on MD industry history — strong rainy-day museum pick.

places.name: Maryland Science Center
places.why: Planetarium, dinos, and interactive floors — classic kid indoor day.
places.hoursNote: Check mdsci.org for hours & special exhibits.

places.name: Fort McHenry National Monument
places.why: Star-Spangled Banner story on the water — patriotic outdoor + visitor center combo.
places.hoursNote: Check nps.gov/fomc for hours & entrance fees.

places.name: The Walters Art Museum
places.why: World-class collections, often free admission — rainy-day culture without a big ticket.

places.name: Baltimore Museum of Art
places.why: Cone Collection and sculpture garden — art day with outdoor spillover when weather cooperates.

places.name: Brookside Gardens
places.why: Formal gardens and conservatory — worth the longer EXAMPLE drive on a bloom day.
places.hoursNote: Check Montgomery Parks for conservatory hours.

places.name: Calvert Marine Museum
places.why: Otters, fossils, and Patuxent estuary — full day-trip with indoor backup.

places.name: Lake Elkhorn / Columbia lakefront
places.why: Paved lake loops and playgrounds — easy stretch-legs day west of Millersville.
places.hoursNote: Open park paths; check Columbia Association for facility notices.

places.name: Thomas Point Shoal Light (view / tours)
places.why: Iconic screwpile lighthouse — shore views from Quiet Waters; boat tours when offered.
places.hoursNote: Tour availability varies — check official notices; do not invent schedules.
